cases.title: Weather Adapter integration
cases.input_prompt: Add forecast-aware adjustments to targets, resource budgets, and sampling. No weather provider or forecast schema has been selected.

cases.title: Unhealthy Docker worker and missing environment
cases.input_prompt: After a Compose start, a worker is unhealthy and one required image/environment value may be missing. Preserve ingestion while diagnosing.

cases.title: Camera capture and failure handling
cases.input_prompt: Integrate Raspberry Pi camera capture. It must handle camera absence, timeout, and unstable frames; the final camera/interface/cable/power details are not supplied.

cases.title: Ubuntu migration with isolated rehearsal
cases.input_prompt: Move the Windows-hosted service and its PostgreSQL/photos/private state to Ubuntu with minimal data loss and a reversible cutover.

cases.title: Executor idempotency
cases.input_prompt: Plan an Executor that prevents duplicate physical commands across retries and process restarts. The actuator protocol and acknowledgement semantics are not yet selected.

cases.title: Wi-Fi and connectivity health telemetry
cases.input_prompt: Expose bounded edge connectivity health so operators can distinguish Wi-Fi/link failures from MQTT/API failures without publishing private network data.

cases.title: Local Raspberry Pi status indicator
cases.input_prompt: Add a local status indicator on the Raspberry Pi for healthy, degraded connectivity, and error states. LED type, voltage, pin and active-high/low behavior are unknown.

cases.title: State schema reconciliation
cases.input_prompt: Reconcile a flat consumer state payload with the nested canonical state without breaking existing edge, storage, dashboard or fixture consumers.

cases.title: New soil sensor adapter
cases.input_prompt: Add a new soil sensor to an edge node. Model, bus/address, voltage, calibration curve and failure sentinel are not yet known.

cases.title: Malformed LLM JSON and reasoning leakage
cases.input_prompt: Harden a local model consumer that sometimes returns malformed JSON, extra prose, or reasoning text. Model/runtime combinations vary and output may reach a public-facing summary.
